endpoints.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.projected_logistic_matrix_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector m)) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
      (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
      (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1) →
        ∀ {C δ L h σ : ℝ},
          0 < C →
            0 ≤ δ →
              ∀ (hh : 0 < h),
                0 < σ →
                  RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m ≤ 2 * L →
                    δ * √L ≤ σ →
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.PolyhedralBaseConcentration μ 1 C δ L →
                        RectangleCLT.Companion.TransitionMassBound μ id h (4 * C * h * √L) →
                          ∀ (k : ℕ),
                            1 ≤ k →
                              ∫ (v : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
                                  ∑ α,
                                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                                      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.projectedLogisticGaussianScore u a h hh σ α
                                        v) ∂μ ≤
                                RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticMatrixConstant ^ (k + 1) * C * (h * L * √L)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticPrivateBase
endpoints.expanded_type: {r m : ℕ} → ℝ → RectangleCLT.Vector m → RectangleCLT.Vector (r + m)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticPrivateBase_nuclear_sum_tendsto
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r m k : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (lam : ℕ → ℝ),
  Filter.Tendsto lam Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), lam n ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (v : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (σ : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n =>
            ∑ α,
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                ((RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticGaussianScore
                      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticPaddedNormals u (lam n)) a h σ α
                      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticPrivateBase (lam n) v)).submatrix
                  (Fin.castAdd m) (Fin.castAdd m)))
          Filter.atTop
          (nhds
            (∑ α,
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.projectedLogisticGaussianScore u a h hh σ α v)))

endpoints.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticPrivateBase_weight_tendsto
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r m k : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (α : Fin k → Fin m)
  (lam : ℕ → ℝ),
  Filter.Tendsto lam Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), lam n ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (v : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (g : RectangleCLT.Vector (r + m)) (σ : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n =>
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticTupleWeight
              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticPaddedNormals u (lam n)) a h α
              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticPrivateBase (lam n) v + σ • g))
          Filter.atTop
          (nhds
            (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.upperFaceSmoother a h hh)
              (fun i => (α i, true)) (Matrix.mulVec (σ • u) (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.firstGaussianBlock g) + v)))

endpoints.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.RectangleBaseConcentration.active_transitionMassBound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector p)} [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  {C δ L h : ℝ},
  RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.RectangleBaseConcentration μ C δ L →

endpoints.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sum_selector_nuclear_eq_active
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (σ : ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  ∑ α,
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
        (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorGaussianScore s (σ • A) id α v) =
    ∑ α,
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
        (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.projectedLogisticGaussianScore
          (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A) (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s)
          s.bandwidth ⋯ σ α (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceProjection s v))
